scripts.build: node scripts/verify-protocol.mjs && pnpm exec tsc -b packages/ui && pnpm --filter @aeon/chrome-extension build
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/verify-protocol.mjs && pnpm exec tsc -b packages/ui --pretty false && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p apps/chrome-extension/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts --max-warnings=0 && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-source-limits.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
